name: MyOps
description:
MyOps is where real estate teams keep their listings, contracts, deals, commissions and expenses. This connector links Claude to your own MyOps account so you can ask for what you need instead of opening reports and filtering lists.

Ask who your top producers are this year, what is under contract right now, what closed last month, how your listings taken compare to your sales, where the money went, or what the numbers are on a particular address. You get an answer in seconds, in plain language, and you can keep asking follow-up questions the way you would with a teammate who knows the whole book of business.

Everything is read-only and scoped to the one team you approve when you connect. What you see follows your MyOps role: owners see team income and expenses, agents see team production and their own money, and documents follow the same rule your MyOps assistant uses, so an agent reads the ones on their own deals. Documents come back as text, never as downloadable files or links. Notes, contacts and tasks stay in the MyOps app.

Sign in with MyOps, pick the team you want to connect, and start asking.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MyOps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MyOps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.myops.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MyOps MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MyOps lists 13 MCP tools, including find_documents, get_current_date, query_active_listings, query_agent_performance, query_closed_sales, query_contract_by_address, query_expenses_summary, query_highest_sale, query_list_to_sale_ratio, query_listings_taken, query_pending_sales, and query_team_income.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MyOps?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MyOps in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
MyOps requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MyOps is developed by MyOps LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
